activity_summary: You sat in the usual pew with Anne and your mother. Your father was not there. Your mother told you to button the cuff, where Saturday's ink still showed, and she would not discuss the empty place. Anne said dinner was after, and that this part was only the sitting down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, and said he had nothing to put in the empty place.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Got him into the pew, and named dinner as later.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the cuff, and refused the empty place as a topic.

entities.name: Holy Trinity
entities.context: Mentioned in Sat in the pew with Anne and your mother

facets.activity: Sat the service at Holy Trinity

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: Button the cuff. The ink is still in it from the night.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: And leave the other place empty. I am not discussing it.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: This part is only the sitting down.
